portInfo.description: CPA states cruise ships dock at the Mega Pier Cruise facility or the Otrobanda wharves in St. Anna Bay, both with full ship services. The Willemstad port page places the Megapier jetty about 200 m west of the bay entrance with 15 m draft alongside and notes it is not subject to St. Anna Bay restrictions that affect traffic under the Queen Emma pontoon bridge and Queen Juliana bridge. Entrance channel navigable width 263.6 m, minimum depth 15.2 m. Rif Seaport master plan (2014 unveil) describes a second mega pier and waterfront village to expand capacity — treat build-out status as unverified unless confirmed on a current CPA schedule page.
